_comment: Forced-choice legibility set (CRITIC.md Mode 4). SIX MATCHED PAIRS: each of six positions gives exactly one idle and one action frame from the identical gameplay camera, so position carries zero information about which class a frame belongs to. A first attempt used one position for all twelve and produced six near-identical idle frames, which a critic can spot and use to infer the control without looking at the character. Every shot uses capture_when (advance until the player really is in that state) rather than capture_at (hand-tuned frame arithmetic, which silently broke when an 8-frame settle was added upstream), and every shot also declares expect_* so capture.gd fails the run on any mismatch. An earlier version of this set silently captured four 'idle' frames of a walking character.

shots._note: CONTROL for this position. Waits until the player genuinely IS idle rather than assuming a frame count, so a shot that inherited a fall or a slide self-corrects instead of quietly captioning a walk cycle as idle.
